decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - Reason for Approval

The means of access by reason of its design and positioning, would not be detrimental to the visual amenity of the street scene or the adjoining properties; nor would it be a hazard and would not give rise to conditions prejudicial to road safety and to the free flow of traffic. It is therefore is deemed to be in accordance with policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development) T.4.4 (Road Safety) and T.5.3. (Vehicle Crossings and Hardstandings) of The London Borough of Hounslow UDP, Adopted December 2003.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority (before the building(s) is/are occupied/used).

Condition : 5 - A splay of 2.4m x 2.4m shall be provided on each side of the access, the depth measured from the back of the footway and the widths outwards from the edges of the access, and no fence, wall or other obstruction to visibility exceeding 0.6m in height above the surface of the adjoining highway shall be erected within the areas of such splays.

Condition : 6 - The width of the means of access at the property's front boundary shall be no greater than 2.4m.  A wall of a height not greater than 1m shall be erected along the entire width of the front boundary with the exception of the means of access before construction on the crossover begins.
description: Installation of vehicular crossover to existing dwellinghouse.
